summary: Researcher and Machine Learning Engineer with solid experience in applied Artificial Intelligence, Computer Vision, Multimodal Models, and High Performance Computing (HPC). Currently working as a Machine Learning Engineer at Datakie, leading technical and architectural decisions for machine learning and generative AI pipelines, alongside conducting scientific research in R&I projects and master's research (PPGIA/PUCPR). Specialized in Computer Vision (semantic and instance segmentation, 3D vision, OpenCV, and lightweight edge models), Multimodal Vision-Language Models (VLMs), Small Language Models (SLMs), and scientific experimentation on supercomputing (HPC) clusters orchestrated with Slurm and remote SSH environments.
goals: To conceive and engineer frontier AI solutions, uniting rigorous scientific experimentation on HPC clusters (Slurm/SSH) with lightweight Computer Vision, VLMs, and efficient models designed for high-impact practical applications.
